confidence_basis: Flags of the frozen radar method on the passes of one event, with no reference compared here; modelled WorldPop 2020 residents; gauge levels read from a public service without a check on the ground.
assumptions: Every figure is read from the frozen M1-z maps of the method lane (bands code_lower, code_central and code_upper; 1 flagged, 0 not flagged, 255 no answer; band reason_central), unchanged. No flag is computed here, and no reference layer is compared.

Land is a 20 m cell whose centre lies in one of the tambons of the frame (the frame lane's unit raster) and that the map does not mark as permanent water (reason code 20: ESA WorldCover 2021 class 80).

Flooded land is the land the map flags. A no-answer cell counts as not flagged, as in the binding chain; the no-answer share is that of the central map (the three maps share their no-answer cells, which the record checks).

A modelled resident (WorldPop 2020, the frame lane's demand cells) is inside when the centre of its 100 m demand cell lies in a flagged 20 m cell: the grid lookup of the score chain. A cell counts for the tambon that holds its centre.

A pass on a partial footprint sees only part of the frame. Outside its scenes, low land gets no answer and high or steep land is answered by terrain, so its totals fall for lack of radar, not for lack of water. Compare passes of one relative orbit, or the figures on the land every pass of a group sees with radar.
Sentinel-1C passes carry the platform offset of protocol amendment 1 as the method lane applied it.

Gauge levels are the thaiwater.net series the consequence lane saved, in Thai time, read at the pass time by linear interpolation between the nearest readings with a value on each side when they are at most 3 hours apart. A gauge level is one point on a river, not a flood extent.
Report only: no score, class or test rule of the case reads these figures.
what_this_is: The time series of protocol nan_case_protocol_v1 (key time_series): the land the frozen M1-z maps flag and the modelled residents inside, per tambon and per Sentinel-1 pass, set beside the Nan River gauge levels at the pass times. Figures only; no map is in this file.

order.rule: The stage runs after the test record exists; a map counts only when its record names this freeze record.
order.flood_input_rule: The pass marked as the flood input of case N1 is the one named under binding in outputs/nan_case/test_1_jaxa_v1.json (test 1 of record, amendment 2) when that record exists, else in outputs/nan_case/test_result_v1.json.

common_radar_land.rule: For each group of passes (every pass; every pass whose radar has a value on at least half of the frame land that terrain does not answer, when that group differs from the others; and the passes of each relative orbit): the frame land where no pass of the group lacks a radar value after (reason no_answer_rtc_no_data_after), and the land each pass flags inside it. These figures can be compared from pass to pass within the group. When a pass of the group sees almost none of the land terrain does not answer, the common land is little more than terrain-answered land, where no pass flags anything.

tambon_rows_note: One row per pass and tambon: land and flooded land (km2), shares of the land, and modelled WorldPop 2020 residents in flagged and in no-answer cells. _lower, _central and _upper are the three frozen maps.

chart.what: Top: the land each pass's map flags in the frame (central marker, lower to upper bar), by relative orbit, hollow for a partial footprint. Bottom: the gauge levels minus each station's min_bank field.

limits: C-band radar does not see water under trees, between buildings or under crops, nor water that drained before the pass.
The passes are hours or days apart; water that came and went between two passes is not in the series.
Residents are modelled 2020 counts, not event-year counts and not people observed in the water.
Planning guidance only; not an official warning.
credits: Radar: contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025), processed by FloodGuard (frozen M1-z).
Residents: WorldPop (www.worldpop.org), University of Southampton, Thailand 100 m 2020, CC BY 4.0. Modelled, not observed.
Tambons: OCHA / HDX Thailand COD-AB (tha_admin3), valid on 2022-01-22.
Gauge levels: thaiwater.net, Hydro-Informatics Institute (RID, EGAT and HII stations).
